title: Inventory sweep: survey idle pumps (WAN bandwidth)
note: A real survey (inventory sweep) planned by the cloud and executed by the kinematic edge (edge_sim, unmodified). WAN metric = the serialized size of the survey report each edge type would transmit: C1 ships an edge-filtered digest (least), C2 ships raw observations (most), C3 ships structured counts (between). Scoped to T7 only: no shared files changed. Only standard survey requests/execution are sent to the deployed cloud -- the per-config report size is measured in the harness, not posted as custom data. C1/C2 use the deployed endpoints; C3 local.
